description: This plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of the Llama-3-8B-Instruct model with SnapKV as the pruning method, comparing various token and bit configurations against a baseline of 4 KV tokens at 4-bit precision. The x-axis represents the layer groups (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32), with a categorical scale and no numeric values or units. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change," with a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, marked at 5% intervals. The plot includes five lines representing different configurations: a baseline of 4 × tokens, 4-bit (gray dashed line), LB-Avg of 2 × tokens, 8-bit (yellow solid line with markers), LB-Avg of 1 × tokens, 16-bit (red solid line with markers), RULER4k of 2 × tokens, 8-bit (light blue solid line with markers), and RULER4k of 1 × tokens, 16-bit (dark blue solid line with markers). The baseline remains steady at 0% across all layer groups. The LB-Avg of 2 × tokens, 8-bit starts at around -0.25% and ends at approximately 0.5%, showing a gradual increase. The LB-Avg of 1 × tokens, 16-bit begins at about -0.5% and ends near -0.25%, remaining relatively stable. The RULER4k of 2 × tokens, 8-bit starts at around -1.25%, decreases to about -6% at Layer13-20, and then rises to roughly -1.25% by Layer29-32. The RULER4k of 1 × tokens, 16-bit begins at approximately -2%, drops to around -15% at Layer13-20, and then increases to about -1.5% by Layer29-32.
